meta.title: Nexo Design — AI-accelerated electronics design
meta.description: Nexo Design combines an experienced electronics engineering team with its own AI platform: research, concept and block diagrams, component selection, electrical simulation and automatic schematic capture.

hero.description: A team of experienced electronics engineers working with our own AI platform. We take your product from idea to schematic in a fraction of the usual time — as your engineering partner, or as a platform for your own team.

mission.title: Hardware moves at the speed of its iterations. We multiply them.
mission.p1: Every board respin costs weeks. We train models on real engineering data so that critical decisions — topology, components, thermal design — are made before the first prototype is built.
mission.p2: We don’t replace engineers — our engineers are the ones using it. The platform lets them evaluate far more alternatives while they focus on what no machine can solve: the intent of the product.

services.title: Engineering services or platform. Or both.
services.intro: Behind Nexo there is a team of electronics engineers with broad experience across many industries. Bring us your whole product, get support on a specific phase, or put our AI platform in your team’s hands.

items.title: Engineering services
items.body: Our engineers take on your project — from requirements and architecture to schematics — using the platform to move faster without cutting corners.
points: Senior engineers with experience in multiple sectors
End-to-end design or support on specific phases
Deliverables you own: block diagrams, component selection, simulations and schematics

items.title: Platform access
items.body: Your engineers work with the same AI workflow we use internally, with our team helping you adopt it and fit it to your processes.
points: The full workflow, from research to schematic
Projects, documents and runs in one place
Onboarding and support from our engineers

platform.title: From requirements to schematic, in one workflow.

steps.title: Describe the product
steps.body: Requirements, constraints, applicable standards and reference documents come together in a single project.

steps.title: AI agents work each phase
steps.body: Research, architecture, components, simulation and schematic are generated phase by phase, each one building on the last.

steps.title: Engineers stay in control
steps.body: Every output can be inspected, edited and re-run before moving on to the next phase.

platform.description: AI agents do the heavy lifting in each phase of the design, and engineers review, edit and approve every result before moving on.

video.label: Product demo
video.caption: The Nexo platform, from a new project to the generated schematic.

capabilities.title: From the first idea to the schematic.

items.title: Research
items.body: AI agents analyse requirements, applicable standards, datasheets and existing solutions to set the technical starting point of the project.

items.title: Concept development & block diagrams
items.body: Candidate concepts are evaluated against the requirements and turned into an editable block diagram of the system architecture.

items.title: Component database
items.body: A component and datasheet database to find, compare and select the right parts for each block of the design.

items.title: Electrical simulation
items.body: Critical circuits are simulated to validate the design before committing to hardware.

items.title: Automatic schematic capture
items.body: Schematics and netlists are generated from the validated architecture and selected components, ready for engineering review.

items.name: Robotics

meta.title: Products and packages — Nexo Design
meta.description: Get the AI electronics design platform, a turnkey engineering team, or the EU/UK regulatory analysis for your product.

hero.description: Subscribe to the platform and design yourself, hand the whole project to our team, or solve only the regulatory side. Packages can be combined.

packages.name: Platform
packages.body: Full access to the AI-assisted design environment: topology exploration, optimized routing, accelerated simulation and DFM validation. For teams that already have engineering and want to multiply their iterations.
features: Cloud environment with dedicated simulation compute
PCB design copilot and component selection
Signal integrity, EMC and thermal simulation
Unlimited users per project and version control

packages.name: Turnkey projects
packages.body: If you don’t have a design team behind you, we take over the full development: architecture, schematics, PCB, firmware, validation and industrialization with European manufacturers.

packages.name: EU / UK compliance
packages.body: Research and analysis of the regulatory requirements that apply to your design in the European Union and the United Kingdom. You get the map of directives, harmonized standards and required tests before certifying.
features: Identification of directives and markings (CE / UKCA)
Applicable harmonized standards (EMC, LVD, RED, RoHS)
Design requirements translated into board rules

addons.title: Add capabilities on top of any package.

items.title: Design audit
items.body: Review of an existing design with a risk report and prioritized improvements.

items.title: Digital twin
items.body: Virtual replica of the hardware to explore variants and anticipate behavior in the field.

items.title: Training
items.body: Onboarding of your team into Nexo’s AI-assisted design flow.

items.title: Priority support
items.body: Direct channel with engineering and a response SLA under 4 hours.
